notes: Company summary: mid-market sales enablement SaaS, productized outbound SDR workflows + CRM integrations.
Primary goal: replace manual SDR outreach drafts and automate follow-up sequencing with a low-latency chat agent in CRM UI.
Workload profile: high QPS chat/agent front-end for SDRs. Heavy streaming usage for live agent UI + tool calls to CRM, Gmail, Calendar.
Latency SLO: p50 < 100ms first token, p95 < 300ms; streaming must feel realtime for agents (no 2-3s stalls).
Throughput estimate: ~1k concurrent agents during peak, ~5-10M tokens/month initially; projected growth x3 in 12 months.
Tool calling: require support for outbound actions - create/update CRM records, send emails, schedule meetings via calendar APIs. Need secure, auditable call logs.
Security: must support SSO/SAML, audit logging of tool calls, KMS integration for key management, and data residency controls for EU customers.
Deployment preference: want to start on Hosted API for rapid iteration (demo & POC) then move to Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable throughput/cost and isolation.
POC plan (agreed): 2-week Hosted API POC with streaming + tool-calling flows integrated into staging CRM, run synthetic load to validate p95 latency and cost per 1M tokens.

Follow-ups: SE to deliver latency tests and example payloads by 2024-06-14; AE to schedule pricing review w/ CFO week of 2024-06-24.
technical_requirements: Streaming API with incremental tokens and sub-200ms per-chunk latency where possible.
Tool calling support (sync and async) with traceable request ids and audit logs.
Prefix/KV caching recommended for common prompts to reduce cost.
Model routing: prefer lower-latency variant for interactive flows; fallback to cost-effective variant for background tasks.
Observability: token-level latency/cost breakdowns per route, per-model; tracing hooks for debugging tool-call failures.
deployment_notes: Start: Hosted API POC in us-east for latency testing.
Target: move to Dedicated with reserved GPU pools if sustained throughput exceeds Hosted cost threshold.
